remarks: Welcome to 13205 Ben Nevis Avenue, a 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offering an excellent opportunity for homeowners and investors alike. The spacious lot also presents potential for an ADU, subject to city requirements and approvals, creating an exciting opportunity for additional living space, rental income, or multigenerational living.
